results.name: BeegSmol Halloween Costumes! - Hololive EN
results.description:
Halloween Costumes commissioned for the BeegSmol avatars of the Vtuber talents from Hololive English Council and Project Hope. The original BeegSmol models were designed by Tsukumo Sana and modelled by me, these costumes were designed by [@Zaniaii](https://twitter.com/Zaniaii)! [Link to their Designs](https://twitter.com/Zaniaii/status/1586964231538155520?s=20&t=5KkW5XHPbebWRZ6eIuf06A)

**notice: to stop the models from being fully black and the outlines to work, select the "Outline" material and make sure "Backface Culling" is turned on.
The disembodied hood and clock on the left are meant to be extra cosmetics that can be toggled, if you dont need them, delete them.**


When downloading and using these models, please note that they are original IP of Cover Corporation, and as such please make sure to follow [their fanwork guidelines!](https://en.hololive.tv/terms), and also remember to be respectful of the talents that used these avatars to represent themselves, thank you!

results.name: Cupid revives Psyche
results.description:
Cupid revives Psyche, relief in marble, after the original model from 1810, Thorvaldsen Museum (Copenhagen, Denmark). Made with Memento beta (now ReMake) from AutoDesk.

With his arrow, Cupid rouses his beloved Psyche. She had succumbed to the temptation to open the jar from the underworld, which turned out to contain a poisonous vapor, rather than a cosmetic.

For more updates, please follow @GeoffreyMarchal on Twitter.

results.name: Early-2000s Cosmetics Box
results.description:
**Early-2000s Inspired Cosmetics Box**

Created in just 4 hours from concept to final render.

**Software Used**:
Modeled in Blender with an optimized poly count and textured in Substance Painter.

**Key Features**:

Textured metallic surface with a smooth, polished finish

Reinforced edges for extra durability

Bold black handle designed for a comfortable, practical grip

Fully animatable lock and lid system for realistic movement

Precisely modeled and textured interior

Crafted with millimeter-level accuracy throughout the entire model
